summary.en-US: Makes Gmail follow your system theme: dark when your computer is in dark mode, back to normal in light mode. No settings, no data collected.

description.en-US:
Gmail on the web stays bright white even after the rest of your computer has switched to dark mode. This add-on makes it follow your system theme instead:

- Dark mode on: Gmail turns dark.
- Light mode on: Gmail goes back to its normal look.
- Switches as soon as your system theme changes, no reload needed.

**How it works**

The add-on inverts Gmail's colours, then inverts images in emails, profile pictures and label colours back so they keep their real colours. Emails designed with a dark background keep their original colours, and Gmail's account menu, Google apps menu and contact cards are darkened too. With a picture theme, only the message list and the open email are darkened. Themes that are already dark, including Gmail's own Dark theme, are left alone.

**Privacy**

It only runs on Gmail (mail.google.com) and on the account menu, apps menu and contact cards Gmail shows from ogs.google.com and contacts.google.com. It makes no network requests and collects no data.

**Credits**

Originally created by Bernardo Lobão ([original repository](https://github.com/bernardolob/Gmail-System-Theme-mode)), with Firefox support and theme detection added by Daniel Demmel. Released under the MIT licence.

This add-on is not made, endorsed or supported by Google. Gmail is a trademark of Google LLC.

release_notes.en-US: First release on addons.mozilla.org. Gmail follows your system theme, along with its account menu, Google apps menu and contact cards, while emails designed with a dark background keep their original colours.
